title: NEON HORIZON 2088 — Cyberpunk 3D Pinball Studio
description: A complete, production-ready interactive 3D cyberpunk pinball game in vanilla HTML/CSS/ES6, rendered with Three.js r128 and simulated with Cannon.js 0.6.2.

tokens.note: Snapshot from the OpenCode session record when the project was packaged. total = input + output + reasoning. Cache reads/writes are reported separately because they are context-usage figures and are not added to the model-token total.

cost.note: As reported by the OpenCode session record.
